name: Muscat de Lunel
terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation in Hérault for vin doux naturel made from Muscat à Petits Grains. It covers four communes, including Lunel and Lunel-Viel.
